descriptions.overview: Overview of your Iceberg migration activity
descriptions.source_banner: Create a source to get started. Sources connect the Migration Assistant to your Glue Data Catalog so tables can be discovered and migrated.

actions.browse_tables: Browse tables available for migration to Iceberg
actions.select_plan: Select a plan to add the tables to

messages.no_draft_plans: No draft plans available. Create a plan first.

actions.configure_plan: Configure the plan settings. Tables are added from the Inventory page after creation.
actions.create_plans_desc: Create plans, add tables from Inventory, then finalize to migrate.
actions.track_migrations: Track and execute finalized migration plans

labels.plan_context: Provide context about the purpose and scope of this migration plan
labels.plan_unique_name: A unique name to identify this migration plan

actions.configure_engine: Configure engine parameters. Changes persist across restarts.

actions.choose_catalog_type: Select the type of data catalog to connect
actions.choose_db_filter: Choose whether to include only specific databases or exclude certain databases during discovery
actions.connect_source: Connect a data catalog source to discover tables for migration
actions.manage_sources: Manage data catalog sources for table discovery

descriptions.db_filter_exclude_desc: Comma-separated list of database names to skip during discovery. Leave blank to import all.
descriptions.db_filter_include_desc: Comma-separated list of database names to import. Only these databases will be scanned.
descriptions.default_ownership_desc: Tables discovered from this source will be assigned to this group by default
descriptions.iam_role_arn_desc: Provide a cross-account or custom IAM role ARN to assume when connecting to the Glue Data Catalog. If left blank, the application will use the default IAM role attached to the application.

labels.source_friendly_name: A friendly name to identify this source

actions.assign_users_desc: Assign users to groups with a specific role (manage or view)
actions.manage_users: Manage users, groups, and role assignments

descriptions.group_desc: Groups are used to assign ownership of migration plans
descriptions.group_membership_desc: Groups you belong to. Contact an admin to modify group assignments.
descriptions.password_requirements: Min 8 characters: 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit, 1 special character.

messages.no_assignments_yet: No group assignments yet. Use the form above to assign users to groups.
messages.no_group_membership: You are not a member of any groups.

actions.add_files_desc: Registers existing Parquet files into Iceberg using the native add_files procedure via EMR Serverless. No data movement — partitioned Parquet only.
actions.add_files_engine_note: Requires EMR Serverless as execution engine.
actions.choose_engine: Choose the compute engine for running migration queries
actions.choose_strategies: Select one or more migration strategies for this plan.
actions.choose_target: Choose where your Iceberg tables will be created

descriptions.bucket_arn_desc: The ARN of the S3 Table Bucket where Iceberg tables will be created
descriptions.engine_athena_desc: Serverless SQL queries. Best for small-to-medium tables and quick setup.
descriptions.engine_emr_desc: Spark-based execution. Best for large tables, complex transforms, and high throughput.
descriptions.incremental_desc: Partition-by-partition rewrite with change tracking. Migrates in batches with minimal downtime.
descriptions.morph_desc: Transforms table format to Iceberg by tracking files and generating manifests dynamically. No data movement — original data stays in place. Supported for Parquet, Hudi, and Delta.
descriptions.no_strategy_error: Select at least one migration strategy.
descriptions.owners_desc: Groups that own this plan — can add tables, edit configuration, and finalize
descriptions.rewrite_desc: Full table rewrite in one shot (CTAS). Clean copy into a new Iceberg table.
descriptions.s3tables_managed_desc: S3 Tables managed migration of Parquet tables directly into Amazon S3 Tables. S3 Tables plans and runs the migration; you review the compatibility report and approve before initating the migration and the cutover.
descriptions.s3tables_managed_target_note: Only available with the Amazon S3 Tables target.
descriptions.s3_tables_swap_note: Not available with Amazon S3 Tables target.
descriptions.swap_tables_desc: When enabled, the original table is dropped and the Iceberg table is renamed to take its place. When disabled, both tables coexist.
descriptions.target_s3_iceberg_desc: Self-managed Iceberg tables stored in your S3 General-Purpose buckets
descriptions.target_s3_tables_desc: Fully managed Iceberg tables with automatic compaction, snapshot management, and optimized performance.

labels.target_locked: Target cannot be changed after plan creation.

descriptions.compare_source_target: Compare source and target for {{target}}. Runs on the plan's execution engine.
descriptions.basic_desc: Fast structural checks — counts, schema, bounds.
descriptions.advanced_desc: Basic plus aggregates, per-partition counts. Slower and higher cost.
descriptions.applicable_subset: The engine runs the applicable subset per table (e.g. partition checks only for partitioned tables). Checks that don't apply are reported as skipped.

descriptions.review_intro: AWS has planned this managed migration. Review the compatibility report below, then approve to begin data movement.
descriptions.request_payload_desc: The exact request the Migration Assistant sent to the AWS S3 Tables StartTableMigration API for this migration.

messages.analysis_not_run: Analysis has not been run yet. Use the AI Assistant to analyze this table.

messages.must_set_password: You must set a new password before continuing.
